facts.summary: West Virginia basic state minimum wage listed by U.S. DOL: $8.75.
facts.evidence_quote: Applicable to employers of 6 or more employees at one location Basic Minimum Rate (per hour): $8.75 Premium Pay After Designated Hours 1 : Weekly - 40
facts.source_title: State Minimum Wage Laws (U.S. DOL Wage and Hour Division)
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Wage and Hour Division
facts.notes: Local (city or county) minimum wages are not included. Scheduled January 1, 2027 increases are not reflected until DOL updates the page.

facts.summary: West Virginia base new employer UI rate: 2.50%.
facts.source_title: Significant Provisions of State Unemployment Insurance Laws, Effective July 2026
facts.source_publisher: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration, Office of Unemployment Insurance
facts.notes: DOL footnote 3: min/max rates apply only to experience-rated employers and exclude surtaxes, surcharges and non-UI taxes. Rate basis: DOL base rate. It may exclude mandatory surcharges, fund-building rates and assessments; check the state agency or total_new_employer_rate where available.
